  * builder                    1 head / fresh   Hydra       . reading...                                                                   
  ! archive               1 head / stale 300s                                                                                              
  ! offline           disconnected / -- heads   Agents                                                                                     
  + Add a host      set up a machine over SSH               . reading...                                                                   
                                                                                                                                           
                                                Hydra can run agents on other machines over SSH, for example a build box with more cores   
                                                or a machine that already has the right toolchain, when a task needs more than this        
                                                machine offers. Adding a host checks its SSH host key and requirements, installs a         
                                                matching Hydra there and helps you install and sign in to agents. Nothing changes on the   
                                                remote until you approve it.                                                               
                                                                                                                                           
                                                Enter continues a host's setup or upgrades its Hydra; e edits and x removes an unfinished  
                                                one. A set-up host's work appears in Work beside local heads; L filters by location.
